appraisal_events.evidence: "je m'entendais adresser la parole par les « gisants » des anciens tombeaux gothiques"... "il écarte les paysans... en disant: « Allez, manants ! »"... "je reconnais qu'il n'a jamais assassiné personne"
appraisal_events.explanation: The duchesse delivers an extended, vivid portrait of Gilbert as an archaic, alien relic out of step with the modern world, softened only by a grudging, backhanded concession at the close.

status_effects.explanation: Gilbert is locally diminished by being cast as a medieval relic, foreign to his own era, whose one saving grace is merely that he has never killed anyone.
The duchesse commands the conversation with an elaborate, cutting, image-rich takedown, holding the floor and steering the exchange with evident verbal mastery.
